hook: Their plane's instrument panel caught fire over the Gulf.
narration: This man was floating in the Gulf of Mexico after his plane went down.
The plane's instrument panel caught fire in flight, so the two men landed it on the water.
A Coast Guard helicopter crew from New Orleans was overhead.
The basket goes down on a steel cable. The survivor climbs in, [short pause] and holds on.
outcome: The New Orleans crew rescued both men from the Gulf.
title: Plane caught fire, landed in the Gulf
description:
Two men were rescued by the Coast Guard after their plane went down in the Gulf of Mexico on Sept. 20, 2012. Their instrument panel caught fire and they made a controlled landing on the water.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, Air Station New Orleans, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/317757/coast-guard-rescues-2-plane-crash
